# Polytraffic

> Traffic diversification frameworks, algorithm update recovery, and platform risk analysis for publishers who refuse to gamble on a single channel.

Polytraffic is a research library on traffic portfolio strategy, channel diversification, algorithm update recovery, and platform risk, written by Victor Valentine Romo (https://victorvalentineromo.com). It is part of the Scale With Search network (https://scalewithsearch.com).

## Key pages

- [Article library](https://polytraffic.com/articles): 490 in-depth articles
- [Have the system built for you](https://polytraffic.com/setup): done-for-you traffic and search infrastructure

## Sections

- [Channels](https://polytraffic.com/channels): 6 topic hubs
- [Economics](https://polytraffic.com/economics): 3 topic hubs
- [Resilience](https://polytraffic.com/resilience)
- [Tools](https://polytraffic.com/tools): 3 topic hubs
